arguments.content:
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]
  SNAP --> PI[_renderPi: >_ + frame + Fa]
```

{"content":"### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]
  SNAP --> PI[_renderPi: >_ + frame + Fa]
  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]
  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]
  LINE --> CLIP[_tailKeep clip ladder: lost > parens > icon]
  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]
  SYM[TuiSymbols presets] --> LINE & ROWS & WAIT[waiting rows: status.pending]
```

</details>

{"content":"### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]

  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]

  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]
  SYM[TuiSymbols presets] --> LINE & ROWS & WAIT[waiting rows: status.pending]
```

{"content":"### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify


{"content":"### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \

  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]
  SNAP --> PI[_renderPi: >_ + frame + Fa]
  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]
  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]
  LINE --> CLIP[_tailKeep clip ladder: lost > parens > icon]
  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]
  SYM[TuiSymbols presets] --> LINE & ROWS & WAIT[waiting rows: status.pending]
```

</details>

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]

  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]

  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]
  SYM[TuiSymbols presets] --> LINE & ROWS & WAIT[waiting rows: status.pending]
```
